Brewa:

The one thing that most people who complain about Archivist rep have in common, is that they don’t understand how the zone (or its reputations) work.

I understand how it works. And that’s the problem. The rep doesn’t work like other reps, and the currency doesn’t work like other currencies. I want to go in and do quests or events to get the bulk of my rep or currency for the day or the week and be done, not roam around endlessly, prey to RNG.

BfA’s Echoes of Ny’alotha and Corrupted Mementos, and Legion’s Veiled Argunite and Wakening Essence were much better in my opinion as you targeted them by activity rather than aimless, endless wandering.

Brewa:

Also, of that list of things you can do in Korthia every day? I have never, ever, not ONCE, actually done all of them in one day.

You simply can’t do all of them in a single day, as they are not all available every daily reset. But you do have to admit that you did most of them every day to have been able to reach tier 6 as soon as you did, before even reaching exalted with Death’s Advance.

You may think that the archivist rep and currency were well designed, which is your opinion. But my opinion is that this is the worst grind the game has ever seen (considering the power rewards tied behind it), and I have done the Insane grind and many others just for the heck of it.
